After his long tour of duty during the Third Succession War, he came home only to see his family gunned down for no apparent reason. His life having lost all meaning, he went on to hunt down every criminal he could find.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 弗兰克·卡斯尔出生在新瓦隆，父母有意大利血统。他入伍联邦太阳国海军陆战队，在战争的各个方面都表现出色，很快被训练为机甲战士。第三次继承战争的漫长服役结束后，他回到家中，却只见家人无故被枪杀。人生失去全部意义之后，他开始追猎他能找到的每一个罪犯。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
Yeah, but imagine that's you:

You get your first look at the 30 ton Trash Can as you move into an intersection. But the Urbie, he knew you were there a long time ago. He moves like a heavy 'Mech: stompy, bobbing his head. And you keep still because you think, maybe, with his cheap Periphery radar he'll lose you if you don't move. But, no. Not the UrbanMech. You stare at him, and he just stares back. That's when the attack comes - not from the front, no - from the side. From the other two Urbies you didn't even know were there.

An UrbanMech is a pack-hunter, you see. He uses coordinated attack patterns and he's out in force today. And he fires at you with an Imperator AC - a 12-ton anti-'Mech weapon - like a sledgehammer on the right arm. They don't bother to go for the cockpit like a Hunchback; they just shoot here, in the center torso and here, in the leg. Or, maybe, on the gyro, spilling you across the tarmac.

Point is: you're alive when they start to eat you.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
是啊，可想象一下那就是你：

当你走进一个十字路口时，你第一次看到那台30吨的"垃圾桶"。但那台城市仔早就在很久以前就知道你在那儿。他像重型机甲一样移动：咚咚踩着步子，脑袋一上一下。你一动不动，因为你想，也许凭着他那廉价的外缘雷达，只要你不动作他就会失去你。但不。城市仔不会。你盯着他，他就只是回盯着你。就在这时攻击来了——不是从正面，不——是从侧面。来自你根本不知道存在的另外两台城市仔。

你看，城市仔是群猎者。他使用协同攻击模式，而今天他倾巢而出。他用一门帝王自动炮——一件12吨重的反机甲武器——像右臂上的一把大锤那样朝你开火。他们不像驼背那样费劲去打座舱；他们就打这里，中央躯干，还有这里，腿部。或者，也许打陀螺仪，把你洒满停机坪。

重点是：他们开始吃你的时候，你还活着。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Alicia \"Hellion\" McEvedy comes from the Deep Periphery, only disclosing that she had a strict upbringing she couldn't stand anymore. A hotheaded, capable pilot, willing to get into the middle of any brawl and surprisingly adept at making LosTech just work. She has a deep distrust towards ComStar and smiles sharkishly when someone mentions the Exodus. She was also known as a Pirate Queen by the name of \"Lady Alekto\".
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 艾丽西亚·"捣蛋鬼"·麦克埃维迪来自深外围区，只肯透露自己受过一种再也无法忍受的严苛管教。她脾气火爆、能力出众，乐于冲进任何近战中心，还出人意料地擅长让失传技术听话运转。她对康星深怀戒心，一有人提起"出埃及"就露出鲨鱼般的笑。她还曾以"阿勒克托女士"之名被称为海盗女王。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Thomas Hobbes was an English philosopher and well-known stuffed tiger.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 托马斯·霍布斯是一位英国哲学家，也是一只著名的毛绒老虎。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Idget was once a tech, solving issues - called 'tickets' in the jargon - that cropped up at work. After a pirate raid which saw massive casualties, the volume of tickets dropped significantly. Seeing such effective ticket-closing action, Idget quickly trained as a MechWarrior, promising to help solve tickets everywhere, one way or another. Working for mercenaries all over, Idget started to receive a reputation of being the best anti-urban-ambush pilot around, due to the methodical way in which buildings were leveled in the area of operations. They say that if you're lucky enough, when the tickets become too deep, Idget will come and save you.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 伊吉特曾是一名技术员，负责解决工作中冒出来的问题——行话叫"工单"。在一次造成大量伤亡的海盗袭击之后，工单量大幅下降。看到如此高效的"清工单"行动，伊吉特迅速受训成为机师，承诺要到处帮忙解决工单，不管用什么办法。伊吉特为各地的雇佣兵工作，逐渐获得了"最擅长反城市伏击的飞行员"的名声，因为他们在行动区域内夷平建筑的手法极为条理分明。他们说，如果你运气够好，当工单积得太深时，伊吉特就会来救你。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An expert marksman, capable of drilling shot after shot through her enemies' defenses. She favors 'Mech chassis that were designed around single weapon types for devastating long-range precision fire. Preferred BattleMechs: Awesome AWS-8Q/T, Catapult CPLT-C1, JagerMech JM6-S/A
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一名神射手，能一发接一发地穿透敌人的防御。她偏爱围绕单一武器类型设计的机甲底盘，以发挥毁灭性的远程精准火力。 偏好机甲：神奇 AWS-8Q/T、弹射器 CPLT-C1、猎手机甲 JM6-S/A

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
An adaptable pilot, capable of flexible responses to changing battlefield situations. When reserving her action she can be a deadly ambusher, striking and fading away before enemies have a chance to react.

<u>Preferred BattleMechs</u>: Any
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
一名适应性强的飞行员，能灵活应对变化的战场态势。当她保留行动时，可以成为致命的伏击者——在敌人有机会反应之前出击并遁去。

<u>偏好机甲</u>：任意

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A stalwart combatant, capable of standing her ground against enemy fire while providing sustained direct fire from a stationary position. Equally capable in long- or short-ranged engagements. Preferred BattleMechs: Atlas AS7-D, Orion ON1-K/V, JagerMech JM6-S, Hunchback HBK-4G/P
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一名坚定的战斗者，能在敌方火力下坚守阵地，从固定位置提供持续直射火力。远距离或近距离交战同样胜任。 偏好机甲：阿特拉斯 AS7-D、猎户座 ON1-K/V、猎手机甲 JM6-S、驼背 HBK-4G/P

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An expert pilot, capable of tremendous feats in a jump-capable 'Mech. He favors flanking attacks, leaping into positions of advantage to set up multiple crossfires. Preferred BattleMechs: Jenner JR7-D, Vindicator VND-1R, Griffin GRF-1S
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一名出色的飞行员，能驾驶具备跳跃能力的机甲做出惊人表现。他偏爱侧翼攻击，跃入有利位置以建立多重交叉火力。 偏好机甲：詹纳 JR7-D、维护者 VND-1R、狮鹫 GRF-1S

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A master of support actions, the Kraken is deadly at any range. Capable of splitting his fire between multiple opponents, he prefers to carry weapons of every range band. Preferred BattleMechs: Centurion CN9-A/AL, Shadow Hawk SHD-2D, Orion ON1-K
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 支援行动的大师，海怪在任何距离都致命。他能把火力分给多个对手，偏爱携带覆盖所有射程段的武器。 偏好机甲：百夫长 CN9-A/AL、暗影鹰 SHD-2D、猎户座 ON1-K

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An expert scout and support pilot. Mockingbird's primary role is providing sensor telemetry on the enemy to her lancemates, but she can hold her own in a fight if she has to. Preferred BattleMechs: Commando COM-2D/1B, UrbanMech UM-R60
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一名出色的侦察与支援飞行员。"反舌鸟"的主要职责是为小队同僚提供敌方的传感器遥测数据，但必要时她也能在战斗中自保。 偏好机甲：突击队员 COM-2D/1B、都市机甲 UM-R60

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A powerhouse fighter who can soak up enemy fire when shooting from a fixed position before bounding in for the final shot, Ozone is fearless and hearty. Preferred BattleMechs: Panther PNT-9R, Quickdraw QKD-5A, Vindicator VND-1R
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一台强力战机，臭氧能在固定位置射击时吸收敌方火力，然后跃出完成最后一击；他无所畏惧且体魄强健。 偏好机甲：黑豹 PNT-9R、快手 QKD-5A、维护者 VND-1R

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An agile pilot with a talent for avoiding incoming fire. He favors short range 'Mechs, nimbly sidestepping attacks while advancing towards the enemy's flank. Preferred BattleMechs: Kintaro KTO-18, Quickdraw QKD-4G, Victor VTR-9B/9S/b>
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一名身手敏捷、擅长躲避来袭火力的飞行员。他偏爱近程机甲，在向敌方侧翼推进的同时灵活侧步避开攻击。 偏好机甲：金太郎 KTO-18、快手 QKD-4G、维克多 VTR-9B/9S/b>

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Part daredevil, part Solaris gladiator, Showboat specializes in Death From Above. She prefers 'Mechs equipped with jump jets, small weapons, and extra armor, in that order. Preferred BattleMechs: UrbanMech UM-R60, Shadow Hawk SHD-2H/D, Griffin GRF-1N/S
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一半是冒险家，一半是索拉里斯角斗士，炫耀女专精"从天而降"。她偏爱装备跳跃推进器、小型武器和额外装甲的机甲，按这个顺序。 偏好战斗机甲：城市机甲 UM-R60、影子鹰 SHD-2H/D、格里芬 GRF-1N/S

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sumo is a calm and brawny marksman who excels at standing his ground against multiple opponents. He tends to favor 'Mechs of the cannon-with-legs variety, trading range for sheer destructive potential and durability. Preferred BattleMechs: Hunchback HBK-4G, Atlas AS7-D, Orion ON1-K/V, Centurion CN9-A/AL
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 相扑是个沉稳而魁梧的神射手，擅长在多个对手面前站稳阵地。他倾向于"带腿的大炮"型机甲，用射程换取纯粹的破坏潜力与耐久性。 偏好战斗机甲：驼背 HBK-4G、阿特拉斯 AS7-D、猎户座 ON1-K/V、百夫长 CN9-A/AL

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A split-fire specialist known for taking on swarms of lighter BattleMechs. She favors 'Mechs of the heavily-armed variety, sacrificing mobility for sheer volume of fire. Preferred BattleMechs: Awesome AWS-8T, BattleMaster BLR-1G, Atlas AS7-D
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 分火专家，以能应对成群轻型机甲闻名。她偏爱重武装型号，以机动性换取纯粹的火力密度。 偏好机甲：神奇 AWS-8T、战将 BLR-1G、阿特拉斯 AS7-D

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A tactician and support pilot, Witness prefers to stay out of the thick of combat until needed. He uses advanced sensor techniques to resolve radar blips into firing solutions for his heavier allies. Preferred BattleMechs: Locust LCT-1V/M/S, Griffin GRF-1N/S
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为战术家与支援飞行员，"目击者"喜欢在需要之前远离战斗核心。他用先进传感器技术把雷达光点转为射击方案，供较重的友军使用。 偏好机甲：蝗虫 LCT-1V/M/S、狮鹫 GRF-1N/S

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
Kodiak was always a studious sort, learning about all the famous Solaris fighters over the centuries and where they and their 'Mechs came from. His research led him into the sights of Interstellar Expeditions, who had realised his knowledge of maps and technology stockpiles from different databanks did not align with their own. During his brief foray working for IE, Kodiak added much knowledge - collated from numerous sources - into the planetary databases of the Inner Sphere and the Periphery, leading to numerous updates to navigational databases across known space.

Becoming moderately wealthy due to the commission from IE, he then received passage to the Princefield Military Academy where he studied the training 'Mechs that still remained there - and learned to pilot these ancient behemoths. After graduation, the cartography royalties have kept him in a comfortable but extremely boring lifestyle, thus leading him into mercenary work. Seeking an outfit using unusual 'Mechs, Kodiak is known for being a steadfast pilot but definitely has the potential to bore other MechWarriors with tales of far-off worlds.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
科迪亚克一向好学，热衷于了解数百年来所有著名的索拉里斯斗士，以及他们和他们的机甲来自何方。他的研究让他进入了星际探险协会（Interstellar Expeditions）的视野，该组织意识到，他对来自不同数据库的地图与技术储备的知识与自家资料并不吻合。在为IE短暂工作期间，科迪亚克将大量从众多来源整理出的知识添入内层星域和外围地区的行星数据库，促成已知空间内多处导航数据库的更新。

由于IE的委托，他变得颇为富有，随后获准前往普林斯菲尔德军事学院，在那里研究仍留存于校内的训练机甲——并学会了驾驶这些古老巨兽。毕业后，地图版税让他过着舒适却极其乏味的生活，这最终促使他投身雇佣兵行业。他寻求使用非常规机甲的部队；科迪亚克以坚定不移的驾驶风格著称，但绝对有本事用远方世界的故事把其他机甲战士烦得够呛。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
Natasha Jackson is our friendly neighborhood Black Marketeer. With her contacts, she can get us anything we need, if we are comfortable with her markups that is. Nicknamed Magpie for her love of shiny things, Natasha somehow manages to live a life of luxury even while on the run. Apparently her old network fell apart when she 'misplaced' a few packages, and she's been running from her creditors ever since. Apparently if we bring her aboard, she'll hook us up with a supply cache somewhere in-system. Even better, she claims to be a qualified mechanic and is licensed to drive a variety of ground crawlers. Maybe we could put her to use as a tank pilot?

XO's note: Boss, I hope you know what you are doing, letting Magpie on the ship. Anyone gets wind of her being on the ship before we are gone and we could have trouble on our hands.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
娜塔莎·杰克逊是我们邻里友好的黑市商人。凭她的人脉，只要我们能接受她的加价，她就能弄到我们需要的任何东西。因喜爱闪亮之物而得绰号"喜鹊"，娜塔莎不知怎么地在逃亡之中还能过上奢华生活。显然她的旧网络因为她"放错"了几个包裹而瓦解，此后她一直在躲避债主。据说如果我们把她带上船，她会在星系内某处给我们接上一处补给藏点。更好的是，她自称是合格技师，还持有驾驶多种地面爬行器的执照。也许我们可以让她当坦克机师？

执行官注：老大，我希望你知道自己在干什么，让喜鹊上船。要是我们出发前有人得知她在船上，我们可能就要有麻烦了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Originally a MechTech in service of House Steiner, he got annoyed having to fix the broken mess he kept being brought. So, one day, he decided to set out into the world to break stuff for other MechTechs to fix.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他原本是施泰纳家族麾下的一名机甲技师，厌倦了不断被送来要他修的破烂货。于是有一天，他决定走进这个世界，去替别的机甲技师制造需要修的东西。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hailing from the Lyran Commonwealth, \"Tex\" is a somewhat hotheaded but private MechWarrior. In typical mercenary fashion he's rowdy but reliable - when he's getting paid. He is also a professor of Inner Sphere history with a strong dislike of clanner society. A veteran of many campaigns, he has time and again demonstrated how to survive until payday.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 来自莱兰联邦的"特克斯"是个有些急躁但寡言的机师。他以典型的雇佣兵作风行事：吵闹却可靠——只要有钱拿。他还是一位内天体历史教授，对氏族社会深恶痛绝。作为历经许多战役的老兵，他一次又一次地展示了如何活到发薪日。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Oddball sees his role as essentially defensive in nature. While our armies are advancing so fast and everyone's knocking themselves out to be heroes, he is holding himself in reserve in case the Clans mount a counteroffensive which threatens Solaris... or maybe even Terra itself. Then he can move in and stop them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 怪球认为自己本质上扮演的是防御性角色。当我们的军队推进得如此之快、人人都拼了命想当英雄时，他把自己留作预备，以防氏族发动反攻威胁索拉里斯……甚至可能是地球本身。到那时他就能出动并阻止他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Nicolette McKinney was born on Tyrlon VI, the middle child of middle-class parents. She was a quiet, undemanding child in a large and noisy family, and spent most of her time reading books. When she was a teenager, she made more friends, started career training, had a romantic relationship... and somehow, without anybody really noticing, Fell In With A Bad Crowd. It wasn't her, not really. It was her lover who, while a wonderful person, just couldn't seem to avoid getting in over their head with some really questionable people. And, over and over again, it was up to Nicolette to get them out of trouble. Eventually, those questionable people started paying Nicolette for her work, and she was lying every holiday to her family about what she did for a living, and she told herself every job was the last one. But every time she thought she'd escaped, her old friend would come back to her again. One day, after providing recon support on a sabotage mission, she realized just how far her employers had stretched. The ruling house of the Aurigan Coalition fell, and she, Nicolette McKinney was, just a tiny bit, culpable. That was the push she needed. She said farewell to her family, wrote a painfully long letter to her old lover, and talked her way onto the first mercenary ship she found leaving the system. She's been fighting ever since, and hoping like hell that nobody from her past life ever tracks her down.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 妮可莱特·麦金尼出生在泰尔隆VI，是一对中产家庭夫妇的中间孩子。在一个喧闹的大家庭里，她是个安静、不惹事的孩子，大部分时间都在读书。十几岁时，她交了更多朋友，开始接受职业培训，谈了一场恋爱……然后不知怎么的，在几乎没人真正注意到的情况下，她"跟一帮坏人混到了一起"。 问题不在她，真的不在。问题在她的恋人——那人虽然是个好人，却似乎总免不了跟一些极其可疑的人纠缠不清。于是一次又一次，都得靠妮可莱特把他们从麻烦里捞出来。最终，那些可疑的人开始为她的"服务"付钱，而她在每个假期都对家人撒谎说自己靠什么谋生，还每次告诉自己这是最后一单。可每当她以为自己终于脱身，那位老朋友又会回到她身边。 有一天，在一次破坏任务中提供侦察支援之后，她意识到自己的雇主已经越界到了何等地步。奥里根联盟的执政家族垮台了，而她，妮可莱特·麦金尼，有一点点、一小点罪责。 那就是她需要的推力。她告别家人，给旧日恋人写了一封长得令人痛苦的信，又凭三寸之舌混上了她找到的第一艘离开该星系的雇佣兵舰船。此后她一直在战斗，并且拼命祈祷上一个生活里的任何人都别找到她。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
Ellis Simonsen was born and raised on a space station orbiting Coromodir V, the only child of a team of engineers who decided to have a child as a bonding exercise. It was, he freely admits, a weird childhood. He managed to develop a completely normal personality, with good metrics in every field that mattered and his parents are still patting themselves on the back about that twenty years later.

He went to a military academy on Coromodir VI, and after graduation pursued further schooling before joining the Royal Guard. There, he quickly became a popular lieutenant due to his mild personality, dependable nature and general patience. Unfortunately, in 3022, a new commanding officer made the mistake of assuming all those positive traits meant he would blindly obey illegal orders.

After incapacitating his commanding officer, he directed his command in the defense of House Arano until it was clear there was no immediate hope in that regard. He then saw to his command's safety before escaping off-world. Now, he works as a mercenary while monitoring the Aurigan situation, waiting for a chance to once again honor his oaths to House Arano.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
埃利斯·西蒙森在环绕科罗莫迪尔V的太空站上出生并长大，是一对工程师夫妇唯一的孩子，他们决定生个孩子作为增进感情的练习。他坦然承认，那是个古怪的童年。他设法发展出了完全正常的性格，在每一个重要领域都有良好指标，二十年后他父母仍在为此沾沾自喜。

他去科罗莫迪尔VI上的一所军事学院读书，毕业后又继续深造，然后加入皇家卫队。在那里，他凭借温和的性格、可靠的天性和一贯的耐心迅速成为一名受欢迎的中尉。不幸的是，3022年，一位新任指挥官犯了个错误，以为那些正面特质意味着他会盲目服从非法命令。

在制服了他的指挥官之后，他指挥自己的部队为阿拉诺家族防守，直到明确看出这方面已无即时希望。随后他先安顿好部下的安全，才逃离行星。如今他做雇佣兵，一边留意奥里根的局势，等着有机会再次履行他对阿拉诺家族的誓言。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
Page Alarcon was born on Ryans Fate, and feels that fully describes them. But just in case you're unfamiliar with Ryans Fate (lucky you!) they're willing to elaborate. They were one of many children of an industrial 'Mech pilot and her technician on a hot, desolate wasteland only valuable for the poison it harbors under the surface.

Page grew up constantly aware of the omnipresence of doom. It was unavoidable, but out of familial respect, Page made at least a token effort and thus made it to adulthood. Then, having already lost two siblings to the mines of Ryans Fate, they carefully weighed the risks and decided that, out of familial respect, piloting a mercenary BattleMech would be safer than staying at home.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
佩奇·阿拉孔出生在瑞安之命，并觉得这已足以完整描述他们。但万一你不熟悉瑞安之命（算你走运！），他们愿意细说。他们是一名工业机甲飞行员与她的技师的众多孩子之一，那颗行星酷热荒凉，唯一的价值就在于地表之下蕴藏的毒物。

佩奇从小就对厄运的无所不在深有体会。这无可避免，但出于对家族的尊重，佩奇还是做了最起码的努力，因此活到了成年。后来，在已经有两个兄弟姐妹死于瑞安之命的矿区之后，他们仔细权衡了风险，决定出于对家族的尊重，驾驶雇佣兵战斗机甲比留在家里更安全。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Tane Bennett was born on the archipelago of Zangul, on one of the roving fleets that served as fishing villages for the planet's solitary starport city. He spent most of his childhood barefoot, learning to climb and jump and instinctively calculate odd angles. When he was nearly grown, he was 'banished' to the starport for complaining too much about fishing. There, he saw his first BattleMech and was thoroughly unimpressed by how big and awkward they were. In the starport, his unique skills earned him unusual attention, and soon he was recruited by a mercenary company for a very particular form of covert operations. However, they neglected to properly indoctrinate him before unleashing him, and when the moment came for him to complete a particularly dishonorable assassination, he froze, fumbled, and fled. That was years ago. He never returned to his original mercenary company, but there are plenty of others. While he initially disliked BattleMechs, he now finds solace in piloting one. It's a way of earning his keep that reveals a face still on Wanted: dispatches only to his mercenary teammates.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 塔内·班尼特出生在赞古尔群岛，生活在为该行星唯一星港城市充当渔村的一支支流动船队上。他童年大部分时间光着脚，学着攀爬、跳跃，并本能地计算古怪的角度。快成年时，他因为对捕鱼抱怨太多而被"流放"到星港。在那里，他第一次见到战斗机甲，并对它们又大又笨的样子大为不以为然。 在星港，他独特的技能引起不寻常的关注，很快他就被一家雇佣兵公司招收，从事一种非常特殊的秘密行动。然而，他们忘了先把他好好洗脑就把他放了出去，当需要他完成一次特别不光彩的刺杀时，他僵住了、搞砸了、逃跑了。 那是多年前的事。他再也没回到原来的雇佣兵公司，但别的公司多的是。虽然起初不喜欢战斗机甲，他如今在驾驶机甲中找到了慰藉。这是一种谋生方式，暴露出一个仍然挂在通缉令上的面孔：只派发给他的雇佣兵队友。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Some people say the spores of the fungal planet Regis Roost instill the inhabitants with a less than serious outlook on life. If so, that isn't apparent in Aadya Mehra. For Aadya, life is stern and life is earnest. She worked very hard on Regis Roost, learning everything she was taught, taking it all seriously. She thought deeply about everything around her; she even read poetry and, as a result, ran into walls a lot. They put her in a 'Mech early as a result. It started as one of those Regis Roost jokes. But the child had a gift, and it did mean she got fewer bruises from running into things. Of course when she grew up, she looked for work as a mercenary. The regular military would have probably kicked her out the first week - or so said her uncles - so it had to be mercenaries if she wanted to get off Regis Roost. And she really, really did. There were other planets with things like trees out there! Now that she has some experience as a mercenary, 'Mockingbird' tries her best to set an example for rookie pilots, and to emulate the more mature ones... sometimes to her own embarrassment.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 有人说真菌行星雷吉斯巢穴的孢子会让居民对人生抱持不太严肃的态度。若果真如此，这在阿迪娅·梅赫拉身上并不明显。对阿迪娅来说，人生是严峻的，人生是认真的。她在雷吉斯巢穴非常用功，把教给她的一切都当真，什么都学。她对周围的一切都深思熟虑；她甚至读诗，结果常常撞上墙壁。 正因如此，他们很早就把她塞进了机甲。起初这只是雷吉斯巢穴那种玩笑。可这孩子有天赋，而且这确实让她撞东西撞出的淤青少了些。当然，长大之后她便去找雇佣兵的活干。正规军队大概第一周就会把她踢出去——她的叔伯们是这么说的——所以如果她想离开雷吉斯巢穴，就只能当雇佣兵。而她真的、真的想离开。外面还有别的行星，那里有树之类的东西！ 如今有了一些雇佣兵经验，"仿声鸟"尽力为新手机师做表率，也努力效仿那些更成熟的人……有时反而闹得自己很难堪。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
Einar Aliyev's bad luck started by being born on Panzyr, where a piece of space debris fell out of the sky and almost crushed the hospital. The only reason he survived his first day was due to the ancient BattleMech torso nearby where a decrepit old MechWarrior was enjoying his lunch. The old-timer saw the falling junk, fired up the 'Mech's lasers and blew it out of the sky. (This was, in fact, the old-timer's job, because stuff fell on Panzyr about every week around the time Einar was born.)

This pretty much set the tone for Einar's childhood. Something awful would happen to him as he was doing perfectly ordinary things like climbing on an overgrown spaceship wreck and yet, somehow, he'd survive. Barely. And then he'd get lectured on how he wasn't being careful enough.

So Einar grew up to be very, very careful indeed. And, as soon as he could, he left Panzyr, before something happened to make it impossible rather than merely very difficult. He had the fond but relieved farewells of his entire township, who rather hoped some of Panzyr's bad luck would go with him.

If it has, it's mostly been turned toward his enemies. He's a very competent MechWarrior, and well-liked among his peers. Nobody believes stories of his jinx, which is nice compared to back home. But he tries to not stay with any one company for long, all the same.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
埃纳尔·阿利耶夫的霉运从他出生在潘泽尔就开始了，当时一块太空残骸从天上掉下来，差点砸扁那间医院。他头一天能活下来，全靠附近那台古老的战斗机甲躯干里有位衰朽的老机师正在享用午餐。那位老家伙看见坠落的垃圾，启动机甲激光器把它打了下来。（事实上这就是老家伙的工作，因为埃纳尔出生前后那段时间，几乎每周都有东西掉在潘泽尔。）

这基本奠定了埃纳尔童年的基调。当他在做爬上一艘过度生长的太空船残骸这种再平常不过的事时，总会有可怕的事情发生，可不知怎么的，他总能活下来。勉强活下来。然后他会被人训话，说他还不够小心。

于是埃纳尔长大后确实非常、非常小心。而且他一有可能就离开潘泽尔，赶在有什么事让它变得不可能、而不仅仅是很难之前。全镇的人都带着喜爱又释然的心情送别他，他们还挺希望潘泽尔的厄运会跟着他走。

如果真跟着走了，那它大多转向了他的敌人。他是个非常能干的机师，在同齐中很受欢迎。没人相信他扫把星的传闻，比起老家这算不错。不过他仍尽量不在任何一家公司待太久。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
Aleksandr Mizahri comes from Tyrlon V, where he probably had parents and was not actually constructed from spare parts by a sentient trash compactor. He grew up, he says, learning to translate between the strongly worded demands of AgroMechs and the overly-relaxed replies of the mail sorting robots.

It was tough keeping the peace between the two factions but somehow, by age ten, he managed it. As a result, he was accepted as a disciple of a particularly enlightened Dig King. While a disciple, he was taught The Way To Paradise, tested, found worthy, and then sent into the sky.

Although his mission is supposedly to spread knowledge of The Way, he's pretty terrible at evangelizing, preferring to drink, laugh, play card games and in general model 'good behavior'.

While the version he gives of his history is frankly ridiculous, there's not much else to be discovered. Born on the street, raised on the street, and coping however he could, he found something that brings him an inner glow and personal balance. He's very hard to rile up, and nobody can deny that he learned somewhere to be an excellent pilot.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
亚历山大·米扎赫里来自泰尔隆 V。在那里他大概有父母，也并非由一台有自我意识的垃圾压缩机用备用零件拼装而成。据他说，他是在"翻译"农用机甲措辞强硬的诉求与邮件分拣机器人过分随意的回复中长大的。

在两个派系间维持和平并不容易，但不知怎的，他到十岁时做到了。因此他被一位格外开明的"挖掘王"收为门徒。作为门徒，他被传授了"通往天堂之路"，经过考验被认为有资格，然后被送入天空。

虽然他的使命号称是传播"道"的知识，但他实在不擅长布道——他更喜欢喝酒、大笑、打牌，以及总体上示范"良好行为"。

他讲述的来历坦白说荒唐可笑，但也查不出别的。生于街头、长于街头，用尽办法应对生活，他找到了某种能带来内心光热与自我平衡的东西。他极难被激怒，而且没人能否认他在某处学到了如何成为一名出色的飞行员。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
Amanda Ahn, who was born on 'a little planet nobody's ever heard of' always knew she was going to be a star. She started out by participating in local talent shows, where she repeatedly won Miss Congeniality, but didn't quite catch on with the local population of farmers and biologists. But after watching the 'Mech dance routine teenage Amanda put together, a supportive great-aunt scraped together the funds to take herself and her young charge off to Solaris VII. There Amanda trialed at several gladiatorial stables before her savvy great-aunt provoked a small bidding war between the stables to get Amanda one of the most excellent rookie contracts in recent history. It was an uncommon move, but Amanda Ahn was an uncommon find even in gladiatorial circles, and she went over big from the beginning. An absolute natural in the cockpit, she was a popular sensation due to her skills, style, optimism, and scrappiness.

She was living her dream, and she loved it, all the way until her great-aunt died. Her new agent, while good at the business end of things, didn't have Amanda's great-aunt's sense of how to protect Amanda's temperament from some of the darker elements of the Solaris VII gladiatorial world. As Amanda coped with the loss of a most beloved mentor, she was still expected to be her famously cheerful self. She couldn't do it alone, and turned to stimulants and alcohol for help. Eventually, as it did with so many gladiators, it backfired on her. Caught up in a hideous scandal, Amanda was advised by her new agent to leave Solaris VII for a few years so the scandal could be forgotten. Ashamed, and glad to escape from the pressures of Solaris VII celebrity, Amanda did so, heading out to the Periphery to take up work as a mercenary and, hopefully, keep her nose clean.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
阿曼达·安生于"一颗没人听说过的小行星"，她始终知道自己会成为明星。她从参加地方才艺表演起步，屡次赢得"最受欢迎奖"，却始终没能真正打动当地的农场主与生物学家。但当人们的看到少女阿曼达编排的"机甲舞蹈"后，一位支持她的姑婆凑钱带着自己和这个小姑娘去了索拉里斯 VII。在那里阿曼达先在几家角斗士马疚试训，随后精明的姑婆挑起几家马疚之间的竞价战，为阿曼达争到了近代史上最优厚的新人合同之一。这是不寻常的一手，但阿曼达·安即使在角斗圈里也是不寻常的发现，她从一开始就大获成功。她驾驶舱里的天赋浑然天成，凭借技艺、风格、乐观与拼劲成为广受欢迎的轰动人物。

她过着自己的梦想，也热爱这一切，直到姑婆去世。她的新经纪人在生意上很在行，却没有姑婆那种本领——懂得如何保护阿曼达的性情不受索拉里斯 VII 角斗圈阴暗面的侵蚀。在阿曼达承受失去至亲导师之痛时，人们仍期待她是那个出了名开朗的自己。她独自撑不下去，转向兴奋剂与酒精求助。最终，正如许多角斗士那样，这反噬了她。卷入一桩骇人丑闻后，新经纪人建议她离开索拉里斯 VII 几年，好让丑闻被淡忘。阿曼达羞愧难当，也庆幸能逃离索拉里斯 VII 名人的压力，于是照做，前往外围区当佣兵，希望能清清白白地过日子。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
Samuel Dannen was a smart but troublesome child who devoured books and holovids about legendary MechWarriors.

Born on Kittery, he watched the 1st Kittery Borderers' exercises near the garrison as he grew up. Too poor to enter the local military academies, he spent years as a civilian, drifting between dead end jobs until he earned a position as a mechanic at the garrison. Some nights after repairing the 'Mechs, he would sneak back in. He spent these nights learning the complicated controls inside each 'Mech. That is until he was discovered one night and fired. No charges were pressed, but the head mechanic couldn't afford to keep him on any longer.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
塞缪尔·丹嫩是个聪明却麻烦的孩子，狼吞虎咽地读着关于传奇机师的书与全息影像。

他出生在基特里，成长过程中常看第一基特里边防军在驻地附近的演习。由于太穷上不起当地军事学院，他做了多年平民，在无前途的工作之间漂泊，直到在驻地谋得一个技师的职位。有些夜晚修完机甲后，他会偷偷溜回去。他用这些夜晚学习每台机甲内部复杂的控制装置。直到某晚被发现并被解雇。没有提起诉讼，但总技师再也养不起他了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Born and raised on Mechdur, Anja Bray was orphaned early in a vehicle accident. She spent part of her childhood in a group home before being fostered with a family of small business owners and philanthropists. They saw that she received a good education, and after, that she had a place in their enterprise. Unfortunately, although she tried very hard to impress her benefactors, she was incurably honest. Not just honest, but truthful, in a way that embarrassed even customers of the business. Her family-turned-employers took her off the sales floor. Nobody wanted her on the admin level, so they sent her back to school for an advanced degree. They intended, eventually, to put her in an advisory position, but their kind intentions were derailed by happenstance. One day, while she was on a field trip, her convoy was attacked by one mercenary company, and rescued by another. During the battle, Anja found herself in a pilotless 'Mech and discovered that the same trait that made her unable to resist describing the problems with products also gave her a keen eye for picking out the perfect shots from a 'Mech cockpit. Well, it wasn't what her foster family wanted for their Anja, but they were too much the businesswomen to let an opportunity like that skate by. Soon Anja was working regularly as a convoy guard, which only lasted until she got bored enough to transfer to a mercenary company. Because, as she told her family, if she was going to sit in a 'Mech all day, she at least wanted to see new places. She promised she'd write them. Her letters have all sorts of interesting details, and they always know that if she says she's all right, she's doing just fine.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 安雅·布雷在梅赫杜尔出生、长大，幼年因一场车祸成为孤儿。她的童年有一段时间在集体之家度过，后被一户经营小生意并热衷慈善的家庭收养。他们让她接受了良好教育，之后又给了她一个在企业中的位置。 不幸的是，尽管她极力想给恩人们留下好印象，她却诚实得无可救药。不只是诚实，而是实话实说——连公司的客户都被她弄得尴尬。从家人变成雇主的他们把她调离销售岗。没人愿意让她待在管理层，于是他们把她送回学校攻读高等学位。他们本打算最终让她做顾问，但这份善意被偶然事件打断。有一天她外出考察时，她的车队遭一家佣兵公司袭击，又被另一家所救。战斗中安雅坐进一台无人驾驶的机甲，发现正是那种让她忍不住挑剔产品问题的特质，也给了她一双从机甲驾驶舱里挑出完美射击的锐眼。 嗯，这并不是养父母为他们的安雅设想的道路，但他们太是生意人了，不会放过这样的机会。很快安雅就常做车队护卫，直到她厌烦了、转入一家佣兵公司。因为正如她告诉家人的：既然她要在机甲里坐一整天，至少想看看新地方。她保证会给他们写信。她的信里有各种有趣的细节，而他们始终知道：只要她说自己没事，那就是一切安好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Carson is lucky. He won't tell you that he is lucky, that'd jinx the whole damn thing. While growing up in Aurigan space on Smithon offered the Volkov family a bigger fraction of safety and peace compared to many other Periphery states, Carson certainly put his luck to the test serving in both infantry and armored divisions for several years. Eventually, he took a discarded Icarus II chassis and found his way into the local gladiatorial circuit and from there, became a merc.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 卡森很幸运。他不会告诉你他很幸运，那样会把事情全毁了。虽然沃尔科夫一家在奥里根空间的史密森长大，比起外围区许多其他国家享有更多几分安全与安宁，卡森却先后在步兵与装甲部队服役数年，着实考验了自己的运气。最终，他弄到一具废弃的"伊卡洛斯 II"底盘，踏进当地的角斗圈，并由此成为佣兵。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Miranda Aguilera grew up in the Lyran Commonwealth. She was a tall kid who made a name for herself as 'the girl you don't mess with'. At eighteen, she signed up with a small-time mercenary company to feed her growing wanderlust. Miranda went undefeated in her crew's drinking games - and in the brawling that usually followed. When her fellow mercenaries turned to piracy, she was in. When they turned over a new leaf, she was out, and looking for a tougher crew.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 米兰达·阿吉莱拉在莱兰联邦长大。她小时候个子很高，以“不好惹的女孩”而闻名。十八岁那年，为了满足日益膨胀的流浪渴望，她加入了一家小规模雇佣兵公司。在队伍的饮酒游戏里，米兰达从未输过——在随后通常发生的斗殴中也是如此。当她的雇佣兵同伴转向海盗行径时，她加入了。当他们改邪归正时，她退出了，并去寻找一支更凶悍的队伍。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 米兰达·阿吉莱拉在莱兰联邦长大。她小时候个子很高，以“不好惹的女孩”而闻名。十八岁那年，为了满足日益膨胀的流浪渴望，她加入了一家小规模雇佣兵公司。在队伍的饮酒游戏里，米兰达从未输过——在随后通常发生的斗殴中也是如此。当她的雇佣兵同伴转向海盗行径时，她加入了。当他们改邪归正时，她退出了，并去寻找一支更凶悍的队伍。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Amir Kowalski was brought up as a loyal scion of House Liao, and sent to a military academy as soon as he was of age. There, he did not disappoint his family name and graduated on time. After graduation, by family request, he was assigned as a naval lieutenant aboard a Capellan Confederation DropShip. He served without particular distinction and was eventually transferred to a MechWarrior unit, which suited his abilities much better. After another tour of duty, in which he developed the motto: 'any battle you walk away from is a victory', he decided he wanted to pursue his own goals, and became a mercenary.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿米尔·科瓦尔斯基作为廖家族的忠诚后裔被抚养长大，一到年龄就被送入军校。他没有辜负家族之名，按时毕业。毕业后应家族要求，他被派往一艘卡佩兰邦联空投舰担任海军中尉。他服役表现平平，最终被调入机甲战士部队——这更适合他的能力。又一轮服役期间，他总结出座右铭："任何你能走出来的战斗都是胜利"；此后他决定追求自己的目标，成为佣兵。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Jessica Chernovskaya had a peaceful and ordinary middle-class childhood in the heart of the Federated Suns. But even in the heart of civilization, you're not safe from a glitch. It was a garbled bioscan that got Jessica committed to a maximum security prison and changed her life. After ten years, her case was re-opened, the evidence re-examined, and her name cleared, but it was far too late for the kid Glitch had been. She'd learned skills on the inside, and she applied them on the outside. Killing for money is surprisingly easy and lucrative, and elite killers can command high prices for their discretion and effectiveness.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 杰西卡·切尔诺夫斯卡娅在联邦太阳国的腹地度过了平静而普通的中产阶层童年。然而即便身处文明的核心地带，你也躲不过一次故障的捉弄。正是一次被扭曲的生物扫描让杰西卡被送进最高安全等级监狱，彻底改变了她的人生。十年之后，她的案件被重新审理，证据得以复核，她的名声也得以洗清——但对于当年那个孩子 Glitch 而言，一切都太迟了。她在狱中学会了一身本领，出狱后便将其付诸实践。为钱杀人出奇地容易，而且利润丰厚；顶尖杀手只要行事谨慎、效率出众，就能索取高昂的报酬。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mohammed Benitez was born on one of Mechdur's lunar colonies and subsequently traveled with his prospector parents all over the system before moving to Katinka. There he attended a local technical school to augment the knowledge he'd picked up while growing up. He spent some time working as a tech on his parents' IndustrialMechs. Eventually, craving more excitement, he hitched a ride on a mercenary DropShip, where he soon talked his way into a BattleMech cockpit. He's never looked back.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 穆罕默德·贝尼特斯出生于梅赫杜尔的一处月球殖民地，此后随其勘探者父母走遍整个星系，最后搬到卡廷卡。在那里他进入当地技术学校，充实了成长过程中积累的知识，并曾为父母的工业机甲担任技师。最终，渴望更多刺激的他搭上一艘雇佣兵空投艇，很快又靠一张嘴混进了战斗机甲座舱。此后他再也没有回头。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 坦克车组测试员。指挥坦克，不能驾驶机甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Grampa Checkers is an old damn man. Even in the Inner Sphere, where age is less of an impediment for MechWarriors due to advanced medical proceedures and prosthetics, Grampa is very old to be a pilot. He didn't age gracefully either, often going off on random tangents and falling down a lot. Still, when you get him on-topic (and on-target), he proves to still be a crackshot in the cockpit. But you still have to deal with him on comms, which might not be worth it. Your call, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 棋盘爷爷是个十足的老家伙。即便在内天体——那里先进的医疗手段与义体让机师的高龄不再是太大障碍——当飞行员对棋盘来说也实在太老了。他的老去也并不体面，常常东拉西扯地跑题，还经常摔倒。不过，只要你能让他聚焦正题（并瞄准目标），他在座舱里依旧是个神枪手。但你还得忍受他在通讯里的唠叨，这或许并不值得。你自己定夺吧，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: More technician than warrior, drone operators are skilled in teleoperation of unmanned recon assets.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这些无人机操作员与其说是战士，不如说是技师，精通无人侦察资产远程操控。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A generic, mediocre vehicle crew with Sensor Lock for when you don't want a combat crew. \"Noncom\" means non-combat, not non-commissioned officer.
